## Summary

```{r}
#| include: false
a2_2_kappa <- function(method, column) {
  analysis2_agreement |>
    dplyr::filter(classification_2 == "HRS/HCAP Algorithm", classification_1 == method) |>
    dplyr::pull({{ column }}) |>
    sprintf(fmt = "%.2f")
}
```

<div style="font-size: 0.75em; line-height: 1.3;">

- Both Core methods take their structure from the HRS/HCAP Algorithm: demographic adjustment set in a robust norms group, plus function, self-report, and informant data.
- Agreement with the HRS/HCAP Algorithm, three classes: Core algorithm `r a2_2_kappa("Core Algorithm", three_class_kappa)`; PMM `r a2_2_kappa("PMM", three_class_kappa)`.
- Agreement for dementia vs. no dementia: Core algorithm `r a2_2_kappa("Core Algorithm", binary_kappa)`; PMM `r a2_2_kappa("PMM", binary_kappa)`.
- CAUTION: these agreement statistics are in-sample (HRS/HCAP used for derivation and evaluation of the Core algorithms.)
- The PMM also gives each person a probability for each class, which carries classification uncertainty into later analyses.

</div>
